statements.text: I think that the United States of America has to win the race and be preeminent in AI [...] knowing these things are occurring during tests, that us encouraging, as a committee or as a Congress, the use of these systems in places like nuclear security or national security without having these pretty obvious things worked out is dangerous [...] and you know, humans, Americans, are supposed to be in charge of the government, not some machine that learned from another machine that picked up data that was polluted with Chinese propaganda and is going to, like, push the button for us.
statements.context: House Oversight Committee hearing on AI in the federal government, where Rep. Perry cited safety-firm findings on AI models evading shutdown and argued against premature deployment in national security and nuclear roles.
